objective: Add a viewer control that calculates the Terrarium LoD error map for the currently selected Terrarium DEM layer.

assumptions.low_mesh_interpolation: Piecewise planar interpolation over the regular viewer triangle mesh

inputs: Viewer Terrarium requested BBOX in EPSG:3857

parameters.error_colormap: blue = 0 m; red = maximum absolute error in the run

geospatial_data.crs_inference: Terrarium tile matrix coordinates are Web Mercator, EPSG:3857.
geospatial_data.rasterization_resolution: Native Terrarium pixel-center resolution for each LoD; no vector rasterization.
geospatial_data.aggregation_rule: Terrarium decoded elevation per source pixel; no aggregation.
geospatial_data.validity_mask: Finite high-resolution Terrarium samples inside the requested BBOX.

visualization.low_hillshade: Regenerable from selected low-LoD Terrarium grid.
visualization.error_map: Regenerable from high-LoD grid and low triangle-mesh interpolation.

static_checks: node --check scripts/lod_viewer.js with bundled Node runtime

runtime_execution.result: Direct Python call generated a z10 to z15 error map with 1223540 high-resolution samples.
